ideas.pitch: An AI-native cloud control plane built specifically on Infriqa to monitor, trace, and auto-heal deployed multi-agent workflows.
ideas.problem_statement: Infriqa: Design. Build. Operate. Challenge - Build the Next Generation of AI Applications from Architecture to Production across the complete engineering lifecycle.
ideas.title: AgentOps Lifecycle Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the 'Operate' pillar (accounting for 35% of judging) by showcasing production-grade monitoring and automated remediation that standard hackathon prototypes completely ignore.

ideas.pitch: Translates high-level system architecture diagrams directly into provisioned cloud infrastructure templates and functional AI service deployments.
ideas.problem_statement: Infriqa: Design. Build. Operate. Challenge - Translate an idea into a scalable application and cloud architecture—defining agents, APIs, data pipelines, and infrastructure dependencies.
ideas.title: ArchToDeploy: Automated Cloud Architect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins on the 'Design' and 'Build' pillars by automating the exact architectural translation judges look for, reducing hours of manual setup into a single workflow.

ideas.pitch: Spins up isolated cloud staging environments on Infriqa, runs automated QA route checks, and has an AI agent validate your RAG pipelines before production release.
ideas.problem_statement: Infriqa: Design. Build. Operate. Challenge - Experience the complete engineering lifecycle: designing scalable architecture, building functional software, deploying it to the cloud, and operating it in production.
ideas.title: ProdRAG: Ephemeral Staging for AI Apps
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of Q-Labs by providing an automated pre-deployment QA agent that makes the live demo exceptionally easy and foolproof for judges to evaluate.

ideas.pitch: A Kubernetes and ArgoCD-backed agent deployment pipeline that syncs repository changes directly to Infriqa cloud runtimes with integrated risk analysis.
ideas.problem_statement: Infriqa: Design. Build. Operate. Challenge - Turn your architecture into working software using modern AI engineering, backend development, and repeatable CI/CD deployments.
ideas.title: GitOps Agentic Pipeline for Infriqa
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard infrastructure engineering combined with cloud-native tooling, perfectly satisfying the rigorous production-operations focus of the Infriqa platform.

ideas.pitch: An internal developer intelligence platform that captures architecture decisions, deployment logs, and runbook updates, converting them into searchable context for incoming engineers.
ideas.problem_statement: Infriqa: Design. Build. Operate. Challenge - Build the Next Generation of AI Applications from Architecture to Production while managing technical operations and documentation.
ideas.title: DevKnowledge Infriqa Sync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Modeled after a 1st-place winner that solved a real developer pain point; judges who manage engineering teams immediately connect with the problem of lost tribal knowledge during cloud migrations.
